FreeLang 컴파일러 Phase 3: Stack-based Runtime VM 구현 설계

## 배경

이미 완성된 컴파일러 파이프라인:
- Lexer → Parser → TypeChecker → Optimizer → IR Generator → CodeGen
- IR Generator가 `ir.Program` 생성

현재 문제: CodeGen은 텍스트 의사 어셈블리만 출력하고 실제 실행이 없음. VM이 필요함.

## IR 구조 (기존)

```go
// internal/ir/ir.go

type Operand struct {
    IsTemp  bool
    Name    string
    IsImm   bool
    ImmVal  int64
    IsLabel bool
}

type Instruction struct {
    Op    Opcode
    Dest  Operand
    Src1  Operand
    Src2  Operand
    Label string
    Fn    string
    Line  int
}

type Function struct {
    Name   string
    Params []string
    Body   []Instruction
}

type Program struct {
    Functions []Function
    Main      []Instruction
}
```

## Opcode 목록 (25개)

OpNoop, OpConst, OpCopy, OpAdd, OpSub, OpMul, OpDiv, 
OpEq, OpNe, OpLt, OpGt, OpLe, OpGe,
OpLabel, OpJump, OpJumpIf, OpJumpIfFalse,
OpCall, OpParam, OpReturn, OpEnter, OpLeave,
OpStructDef, OpFieldLoad, OpFieldStore, OpSyscall

## Builtin 레지스트리 (기존, internal/builtin/)

```go
type BuiltinDef struct {
    Name           string
    ParamTypeNames []string
    ReturnTypeName string
    Impl           func(args ...interface{}) interface{}
}
func Lookup(name string) (BuiltinDef, bool)
func IsBuiltin(name string) bool
```

## 제약사항

- ARM64 Android (Termux) 환경 - 빌드는 되지만 실행은 제한적
- `go build ./...` 성공이 목표
- 단순하고 정확한 구현 우선
- 새 패키지: `internal/runtime/`

## 구현 요청

아래 구조로 Phase 3 런타임 구현 계획을 제시해주세요:

### 1. Value 타입 설계 (internal/runtime/value.go)
- int64, bool, string, nil, 향후 확장 고려
- struct 인스턴스 (필드 맵으로 단순 처리)
- array ([]Value)

### 2. CallFrame 설계 (internal/runtime/frame.go)
- 로컬 변수/임시 변수 환경 (map[string]Value)
- 파라미터 수신
- 반환값 처리

### 3. VM 핵심 설계 (internal/runtime/vm.go)
- 레이블 → 인덱스 맵 사전 구축
- 명령어 실행 루프 (switch on Opcode)
- 함수 호출 스택 ([]CallFrame)
- Builtin 함수 연결

### 4. main.go 통합
- `run` 명령어 추가: `./freelang run <code>` → 컴파일 후 VM 실행

### 5. 테스트 계획 (internal/runtime/runtime_test.go)
- 5개 통합 테스트

각 파일의 예상 줄수와 핵심 코드 스니펫 포함해주세요.

36	// Operand represents a value in an instruction (register, immediate, or label)
37	type Operand struct {
38		IsTemp  bool   // true if this is a temporary (t0, t1, ...)
39		Name    string // variable name or temp name
40		IsImm   bool   // true if this is an immediate integer
41		ImmVal  int64  // immediate value
42		IsLabel bool   // true if this is a label reference
43	}
44	
45	// Instruction is a three-address code instruction
46	type Instruction struct {
47		Op    Opcode
48		Dest  Operand
49		Src1  Operand
50		Src2  Operand
51		Label string // for OpLabel, OpJump, OpJumpIf, OpJumpIfFalse
52		Fn    string // for OpCall, OpEnter, OpLeave
53		Line  int    // source line number
54	}
55	
56	// Function represents a function in IR
57	type Function struct {
58		Name   string
59		Params []string
60		Body   []Instruction
61	}
62	
63	// Program represents a complete program in IR
64	type Program struct {
65		Functions []Function
66		Main      []Instruction
67	}
68	
69	// ByteSize returns the estimated byte size of the program (4 bytes per instruction)
70	func (p *Program) ByteSize() int {
71		count := len(p.Main)
72		for _, fn := range p.Functions {
73			count += len(fn.Body)
74		}
75		return count * 4
76	}

72		l := lexer.New(code)

92		printAST(prog, 0)

95	func printAST(node *ast.Node, indent int) {
96		if node == nil {
97			return
98		}
99		indentStr := ""
100		for i := 0; i < indent; i++ {
101			indentStr += "  "
102		}
103		fmt.Printf("%sNode(kind=%v, value=%q)\n", indentStr, node.Kind, node.Value)
104		for _, child := range node.Children {
105			printAST(child, indent+1)
106		}
107	}

176	func compileCode(code string) {
177		start := time.Now()
178	
179		// Step 1: Parse
180		p := parser.New(code)
181		prog, err := p.ParseProgram()
182		if err != nil {
183			fmt.Printf("Parse error: %v\n", err)
184			return
185		}
186	
187		// Step 1.5: Type check
188		tc := typesys.NewTypeChecker()
189		if typeErrs := tc.Check(prog); len(typeErrs) > 0 {
190			fmt.Println("=== Type Errors ===")
191			for _, e := range typeErrs {
192				fmt.Printf("  line %d, col %d: %s\n", e.Line, e.Col, e.Message)
193			}
194			// Soft mode: warn but continue compilation
195			fmt.Println("(Continuing compilation in soft mode...)")
196		}
197	
198		// Step 2: Collect patterns
199		collector := profiler.NewCollector()
200		collector.CollectFromAST(prog)
201	
202		// Step 3: Load DB and update priorities
203		dbPath := filepath.Join(".", "pattern-db.json")
204		db, _ := profiler.LoadFromFile(dbPath)
205	
206		// Step 4: Optimize
207		opt := optimizer.NewAdaptiveOptimizer()
208		opt.UpdatePriorities(db)
209		optimized, stats := opt.OptimizeWithStats(prog)
210	
211		// Step 5: Generate IR
212		gen := ir.NewGenerator()
213		irProg, err := gen.Generate(optimized)
214		if err != nil {
215			fmt.Printf("IR generation error: %v\n", err)
216			return
217		}
218	
219		// Step 6: Generate code
220		cg := codegen.New()
221		result := cg.Generate(irProg)
222	
223		// Step 7: Calculate build metrics
224		buildTimeNs := time.Since(start).Nanoseconds()
225	
226		// Step 8: Record build
227		recorder := evolution.NewEvolutionRecorder()
228		sourceHash := fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256([]byte(code)))[:8]
229		metric := recorder.RecordBuild(buildTimeNs, stats.RulesApplied, result.ByteSize, sourceHash)
230	
231		// Step 9: Check health
232		detector := evolution.NewRegressionDetector(recorder)
233		health := detector.GetHealthStatus()
234	
235		// Step 10: Update and save DB
236		db.UpdateFromCollector(collector, code)
237		db.SaveToFile(dbPath)
238	
239		// Output
240		fmt.Println("=== Generated Code ===")
241		fmt.Println(result.Code)
242		fmt.Printf("\n=== Build Metrics ===\n")
243		fmt.Printf("Build ID: %s\n", metric.BuildID)
244		fmt.Printf("Build time: %d ns (%.2f ms)\n", metric.BuildTimeNs, float64(metric.BuildTimeNs)/1000000)
245		fmt.Printf("Optimizations applied: %d\n", metric.OptsPassed)
246		fmt.Printf("Code size: %d bytes\n", metric.CodeSizeBy)
247		fmt.Printf("Health status: %s\n", health)
248		fmt.Printf("Optimization rules: %v\n", stats.RulesApplied)
249	}

1	// Package builtin implements the standard library built-in functions for FreeLang
2	package builtin
3	
4	// BuiltinDef represents a built-in function definition
5	type BuiltinDef struct {
6		Name           string
7		ParamTypeNames []string                             // parameter type names (e.g., "string", "int")
8		ReturnTypeName string                               // return type name
9		Impl           func(args ...interface{}) interface{} // implementation
10	}
11	
12	// registry holds all registered built-in functions
13	var registry = make(map[string]BuiltinDef)
14	
15	// Register adds a built-in function to the registry
16	func Register(b BuiltinDef) {
17		registry[b.Name] = b
18	}
19	
20	// Lookup finds a built-in function by name
21	func Lookup(name string) (BuiltinDef, bool) {
22		def, exists := registry[name]
23		return def, exists
24	}
25	
26	// IsBuiltin checks if a name is a built-in function
27	func IsBuiltin(name string) bool {
28		_, exists := registry[name]
29		return exists
30	}
31	
32	// AllDefs returns all registered built-in definitions
33	func AllDefs() []BuiltinDef {
34		defs := make([]BuiltinDef, 0, len(registry))
35		for _, def := range registry {
36			defs = append(defs, def)
37		}
38		return defs
39	}
40	
41	// init initializes the built-in registry by calling the register functions
42	// from io, string, and array packages
43	func init() {
44		registerIOBuiltins()
45		registerStringBuiltins()
46		registerArrayBuiltins()
47	}

2	package codegen
3

5		"fmt"

11	// Result contains generated code and metrics
12	type Result struct {
13		Code      string // Generated pseudo-assembly text
14		ByteSize  int    // Length of generated code in bytes
15		LineCount int    // Number of lines in output
16	}

18	// CodeGen generates pseudo-assembly from IR
19	type CodeGen struct {
20		code      strings.Builder
21		lineCount int

24	// New creates a new code generator
25	func New() *CodeGen {
26		return &CodeGen{
27			lineCount: 0,
28		}
29	}
30	
31	// Generate converts IR program to pseudo-assembly
32	func (cg *CodeGen) Generate(prog *ir.Program) Result {
33		cg.code.Reset()
34		cg.lineCount = 0
35	
36		// Generate functions
37		for _, fn := range prog.Functions {
38			cg.generateFunction(fn)
39		}
40	
41		// Generate main
42		if len(prog.Main) > 0 {
43			cg.writeLine("; === main ===")
44			cg.generateInstructions(prog.Main)
45		}
46	
47		code := cg.code.String()
48		return Result{
49			Code:      code,
50			ByteSize:  len(code),
51			LineCount: cg.lineCount,
52		}
53	}
54	
55	// generateFunction generates code for a single function
56	func (cg *CodeGen) generateFunction(fn ir.Function) {
57		cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("; === function %s ===", fn.Name))
58		cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("ENTER %s", fn.Name))
59	
60		cg.generateInstructions(fn.Body)
61	
62		// Ensure LEAVE is present
63		if len(fn.Body) == 0 || fn.Body[len(fn.Body)-1].Op != ir.OpLeave {
64			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("LEAVE %s", fn.Name))
65		}
66	
67		cg.writeLine("")
68	}
69	
70	// generateInstructions generates code for a list of instructions
71	func (cg *CodeGen) generateInstructions(instrs []ir.Instruction) {
72		for _, instr := range instrs {
73			cg.generateInstruction(instr)
74		}
75	}
76	
77	// generateInstruction generates code for a single instruction
78	func (cg *CodeGen) generateInstruction(instr ir.Instruction) {
79		switch instr.Op {
80		case ir.OpConst:
81			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  LOAD %s, #%d", cg.formatOperand(instr.Dest), instr.Src1.ImmVal))
82	
83		case ir.OpCopy:
84			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  COPY %s, %s", cg.formatOperand(instr.Dest), cg.formatOperand(instr.Src1)))
85	
86		case ir.OpAdd:
87			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  ADD %s, %s, %s",
88				cg.formatOperand(instr.Dest),
89				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src1),
90				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src2)))
91	
92		case ir.OpSub:
93			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  SUB %s, %s, %s",
94				cg.formatOperand(instr.Dest),
95				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src1),
96				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src2)))
97	
98		case ir.OpMul:
99			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  MUL %s, %s, %s",
100				cg.formatOperand(instr.Dest),
101				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src1),
102				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src2)))
103	
104		case ir.OpDiv:
105			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  DIV %s, %s, %s",
106				cg.formatOperand(instr.Dest),
107				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src1),
108				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src2)))
109	
110		case ir.OpEq:
111			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  CMP %s, %s, == %s",
112				cg.formatOperand(instr.Dest),
113				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src1),
114				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src2)))
115	
116		case ir.OpNe:
117			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  CMP %s, %s, != %s",
118				cg.formatOperand(instr.Dest),
119				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src1),
120				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src2)))
121	
122		case ir.OpLt:
123			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  CMP %s, %s, < %s",
124				cg.formatOperand(instr.Dest),
125				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src1),
126				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src2)))
127	
128		case ir.OpGt:
129			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  CMP %s, %s, > %s",
130				cg.formatOperand(instr.Dest),
131				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src1),
132				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src2)))
133	
134		case ir.OpLe:
135			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  CMP %s, %s, <= %s",
136				cg.formatOperand(instr.Dest),
137				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src1),
138				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src2)))
139	
140		case ir.OpGe:
141			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  CMP %s, %s, >= %s",
142				cg.formatOperand(instr.Dest),
143				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src1),
144				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src2)))
145	
146		case ir.OpLabel:
147			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("%s:", instr.Label))
148	
149		case ir.OpJump:
150			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  JUMP %s", instr.Label))
151	
152		case ir.OpJumpIf:
153			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  JIT %s, %s", cg.formatOperand(instr.Src1), instr.Label))
154	
155		case ir.OpJumpIfFalse:
156			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  JLF %s, %s", cg.formatOperand(instr.Src1), instr.Label))
157	
158		case ir.OpCall:
159			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  CALL %s, %s", cg.formatOperand(instr.Dest), instr.Fn))
160	
161		case ir.OpParam:
162			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  PARAM %s", cg.formatOperand(instr.Src1)))
163	
164		case ir.OpReturn:
165			if instr.Src1.Name != "" || instr.Src1.IsImm {
166				cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  RET %s", cg.formatOperand(instr.Src1)))
167			} else {
168				cg.writeLine("  RET")
169			}
170	
171		case ir.OpEnter:
172			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("ENTER %s", instr.Fn))
173	
174		case ir.OpLeave:
175			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("LEAVE %s", instr.Fn))
176	
177		case ir.OpStructDef:
178			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("; STRUCT %s size=%d", instr.Fn, instr.Src1.ImmVal))
179	
180		case ir.OpFieldLoad:
181			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  LOAD %s, [%s+%d]",
182				cg.formatOperand(instr.Dest),
183				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src1),
184				instr.Src2.ImmVal))
185	
186		case ir.OpFieldStore:
187			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  STORE [%s+%d], %s",
188				cg.formatOperand(instr.Dest),
189				instr.Src1.ImmVal,
190				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src2)))
191	
192		case ir.OpSyscall:
193			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  SVC %s", cg.formatOperand(instr.Dest)))
194	
195		case ir.OpNoop:
196			// Skip noop instructions
197		}
198	}

200	// formatOperand converts an operand to text representation
201	func (cg *CodeGen) formatOperand(op ir.Operand) string {
202		if op.IsImm {
203			return fmt.Sprintf("#%d", op.ImmVal)
204		}
205		if op.IsLabel {
206			return op.Name
207		}
208		return op.Name
209	}
210	
211	// writeLine appends a line to the output
212	func (cg *CodeGen) writeLine(line string) {
213		cg.code.WriteString(line)
214		cg.code.WriteString("\n")
215		cg.lineCount++
216	}
